title: CarrierInvoice
description: A Carrier's invoice, as the Carrier sends it to the Norvia Partner API (Carrier invoice format, version 1). It follows the Carrier booking format: its own field names, the Carrier's own booking reference as bookingRef and local dates formatted dd-MM-yyyy. It differs from the Canonical Model on purpose. It never names the Carrier or a correlation ID: API Management takes the Carrier from the token (ADR 0005) and creates the correlation ID. Amounts are in EUR without VAT.

invoiceNo.description: The Carrier's own invoice number. It is the key of the invoice: unique per Carrier, and an invoice sent again with the same content is acknowledged and ignored.

invoiceDate.description: The date of the invoice, a local date as dd-MM-yyyy.

lines.description: One line per Carrier booking the Carrier claims, with no bookingRef twice.

bookingRef.description: The Carrier's own reference for the booking, as it gave it when it confirmed.

amount.description: What the Carrier claims for the booking in EUR, without VAT: above zero, to the cent.
